we have proposed a two-stream network for gesture recognition using a compact yet efficient representation of hand gestures.
the proposed two stream fusion model is able to achieve state-of-the-art results on two datasets.
the proposed two stream fusion model with optical flow guided motion template can achieve a recognition accuracy of 99.3% on the dataset of 20 hand gestures.
